card.title: Fuse Amperage Rating Marking Code Reference Table

source.title: Fuse Part Marking System Reference Table

claims.statement: Surface-mount fuses can be identified by their printed marking codes corresponding to specific amperage ratings.
claims.evidence: The table maps 'Amp Code' values to their respective 'Marking Code' visual representations.

card.caveats: This table provides a mapping for marking codes to amperage ratings but does not specify the manufacturer or physical package type of the fuses.
